description_en: Creates a whiteboard document and retrieves the document identifier (DocKey)
description_zh: 创建白板文档，获取白板文档标识DocKey
name: CreateWhiteBoard

parameters.help_en: The user ID (business user) who creates the whiteboard. The value is 1 to 32 characters in length and can contain uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, underscores, and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh: 创建白板的用户ID（客户业务用户），由1~32位大小写字母、数字、下划线、短划线（-）组成
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the whiteboard application. To obtain the AppID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204234.html
parameters.help_zh: 白板应用唯一标识符。获取AppID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204234.html
parameters.name: app_id
